Container.Name: dendrop
Container.Overview: Private, self-hosted chat for family and friends: DMs, group chats, chat servers, end-to-end encryption, and voice and video calls. One container: the web app, the API and the call server are all in it. Sign in with TinyAuth (or any OpenID Connect provider) or a username and password.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The web app and API. Put this behind your reverse proxy with HTTPS (calls need it too, and go through the same address).

Config.Name: Calls TCP port
Config.Description: Call audio and video, fallback when UDP is blocked. Host and container port must be the same number. Forward it on your router for calls away from home.

Config.Name: Calls UDP port
Config.Description: Call audio and video. Host and container port must be the same number. Forward it (UDP) on your router for calls away from home.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: The database, uploaded files and keys. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: The address people use, e.g. https://chat.example.com. Needed for TinyAuth sign-in and secure cookies.

Config.Name: HTTPS
Config.Description: Leave empty behind a reverse proxy or Tailscale. Set to self-signed to serve https:// on the Web UI port yourself (browsers warn once per device), so encryption and calls work without a proxy. Then open https://IP:PORT. See docs/HTTPS.md.

Config.Name: TinyAuth issuer
Config.Description: Your TinyAuth address, e.g. https://auth.example.com. Leave empty to sign in with usernames and passwords only.

Config.Name: TinyAuth client ID
Config.Description: From the OIDC client you add in TinyAuth, with redirect URL https://YOUR-ADDRESS/api/auth/oidc/callback

Config.Name: TinyAuth client secret
Config.Description: From the same TinyAuth OIDC client.

Config.Name: Google client ID
Config.Description: Optional: Sign in with Google. An OAuth client from Google Cloud with redirect URI https://YOUR-ADDRESS/api/auth/google/callback (see docs/SIGN-IN.md).

Config.Name: Google client secret
Config.Description: From the same Google OAuth client.

Config.Name: TinyAuth admin group
Config.Description: Members of this group become super admins. Optional.

Config.Name: Calls
Config.Description: on or off. Off hides the call buttons and doesn't start the call server.

Config.Name: Calls public IP
Config.Description: Leave empty: the call server finds your public IP itself. Set it if that fails, e.g. no internet at start-up.

Config.Name: Username and password sign-in
Config.Description: true or false. On so the first (admin) account can be made; turn off once everyone uses TinyAuth.

Config.Name: Max upload (MB)
Config.Description: Largest file a message can carry.

Config.Name: Allow http:// push
Config.Description: true only if you run your own ntfy server on the home network over plain http.

Config.Name: Apple push key file
Config.Description: For the iPhone app: path inside the container to your APNs .p8 key, e.g. /data/AuthKey_ABCDE12345.p8 (put the file in the appdata folder). See packages/ios/README.md.

Config.Name: Apple push key ID
Config.Description: For the iPhone app: the 10-character Key ID shown next to the APNs key in your Apple developer account.

Config.Name: Apple team ID
Config.Description: For the iPhone app: your Apple developer Team ID (Membership details).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the server runs as (99 is nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the server runs as (100 is users).
